# OpenUI Studio for DeepSeek Harness
English | 简体中文

OpenUI Studio adds an on-demand `/openui` command to a normal DeepSeek Harness
(DSH) conversation. I

t generates OpenUI Lang with the
selected model, validates the result against the official OpenUI ch

at library,
and renders it in the conversation with the official OpenUI Renderer. DSH still
owns the
conversation, reasoning, history, tool records, and composer.
## Quick start

1. Have DSH installed and select a default model in **Settings → Models**.
2. In **Settings → Plugin

s → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-openui-studio`. Fully
quit and reopen DSH after installation or an upda

te. You can also install
directly from the GitHub repository.

The agent calls `openui_generate` with the relevant conversation context. A
valid result is saved as

a DSH tool result and shown in the main chat. If the
first result fails OpenUI validation, the plug

in makes one repair call. If it
still fails, DSH shows a tool error; no partial interface is saved.

Reopening a
conversation renders its saved result without another model call.

For OpenUI source generation, the plugin follows the current DSH conversation's
model, output-token

budget, and reasoning effort. If the model produces no usable text, the tool error reports
the strea

m's finish reason, chunk counts, and raw text length without logging
the model's content. The tool w

ill not start another generation in the same
`/openui` turn. Send a new `/openui` request to retry a

nother generation in the same
`/openui` turn. Send a new `/openui` request to retry after a failure.

Buttons in an OpenUI answer insert their suggested question into the DSH
composer and focus it. They
never send a message automatically.
## Drawing and replay

New answers use the Swarm Rebuild engine to reconstruct the rendered answer
layer by layer. Its curs

ors draw frames, type text, place media, duplicate
repeated elements, adjust dimensions, and use ali

gnment guides. The tour
scrolls through unfinished work, then returns directly to the live OpenUI an

swer.
The viewport follows the leading active work, slowing down in dense sections
and speeding up a

cross sparse ones. The handoff waits until the conversation
reaches the answer's end, then briefly c

rossfades to the live page.
Playback starts with readable answer content; there is no cursor-only in

fades to the live page.
Playback starts with readable answer content; there is no cursor-only intro.

Saved answers open immediately. Click the **replay** icon beside **OpenUI
Studio** to rebuild one wi

thout generating it again. Click the canvas or press
Escape to return to the interactive answer. Pla

yback is skipped when reduced
motion is requested or a new answer finishes while DSH is in the backg

round.
The drawing controls follow DSH's light or dark theme; switching themes during
playback retur
ns to the live answer.

The animation snapshots the already-rendered OpenUI DOM. It does not alter the
OpenUI Lang result or
add records to the conversation.
## Render settings

Edit `render.js` to customize the presentation layer. Use the
configuration icon beside **OpenUI Stu

dio** to open it in DSH, or edit the file
directly. It exports one JavaScript object:
| Setting | Default | Effect |

| `showEditButton` | `true` | Show the icon that opens `render.js`. |
| `toolbar` | `['replay']` | O

rder or hide `replay`, `debug`, and `download-log`. |
| `animation.autoPlay` | `true` | Draw newly g

enerated answers automatically. Manual replay remains available. |
| `animation.followScroll` | `tru
e` | Follow the reconstruction down the conversation. When `false`, show the complete answer immedia

tely. |
| `css` | Bundled stylesheet | Scoped CSS overrides for the OpenUI answer. |

The `css` string includes typography variables such as
`--openui-studio-font`, `--openui-studio-body

-size`,
`--openui-studio-body-leading`, and `--openui-studio-heading-size`. Keep custom
selectors un

der `.openui-answer` or `.openui-native` so they do not affect DSH.
These settings change rendering

and controls, not the LLM prompt or saved
answer. Fully quit and reopen DSH after editing `render.js

`; no build or new
model call is needed. Invalid settings fall back to the bundled defaults and
show
an error beside the answer title.

Model-call settings live separately in `cordis.patch.yml`:
`provider`, `model`, `maxTokens`, `temper

ature`, `reasoningEffort`,
`maxQuestionChars`, and `promptSuffix`. Leave the model and generation se

ttings
`null` to use the current DSH conversation's request settings. When a session
has no token bu

dget, the plugin reads the selected model's `defaultMaxTokens`;
if that is unavailable, it lets DSH

choose. A non-null plugin value overrides
the corresponding session setting. `maxQuestionChars` limi

ts the question sent
to the generator, and `promptSuffix` appends environment-specific instructions

to the generated official OpenUI prompt. The base prompt and validation schema
still come from the i

nstalled OpenUI package. Restart DSH after changing the
plugin configuration. A profile's `cordis.pa

tch.yml` is applied after the

## Animation diagnostics

1. Set `toolbar: ['replay', 'debug', 'download-log']` in `render.js` and restart
DSH.
2. Click the b

ug icon beside **OpenUI Studio** to replay while recording block,
cursor, animation, scroll, and fin

ish events.
3. When playback ends, click the download icon to save the JSON log.

The log contains timing and geometry, not answer text. No DevTools Console is
required. Debug and do
wnload buttons are hidden by the default toolbar.
